ENGINEERING MECHANICS STATICS

  Equilibrium

  When a body is in equilibrium, the resultant of all forces acting on it is zero. Thus, the
  resultant force R and the resultant couple M are both zero, and we have the equilibrium
  equations

  R = ΣF = 0

 M = ΣM = 0





  Free-body diagram, which is a diagrammatic representation of the isolated system treated
  as a single body.

  Free-body diagram  is the most important single step  in the solution  of problems  in
  mechanics.




                           S V Venkatesh - Engineering Mechanics Statics – Unit 2 – Chapter 3 - Equilibrium
